final_candidates.decision_summary: Disrupts the critical N330 N-glycan sequon at the V3 base, conferring strong immune escape from PGT121-class bNAbs while preserving Env trimer structure and viral replication fitness.
Eliminates the conserved N151 N-glycan in the V1/V2 apex targeted by PG9/PG16 bNAbs, driving robust antibody escape with high structural tolerance.
Removes the Loop D N275 glycan involved in CD4 binding site bNAb recognition, enabling escape from VRC01-class antibodies while retaining viral entry function.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 mutations selected and verified against sequence coordinates.

history.rationale: Eliminates the high-mannose glycan sequon at N330 (N332 in HXB2 numbering), conferring broad resistance to V3-glycan targeting antibodies like PGT121 while maintaining overall HIV-1 Env folding and fitness.
Disrupts the critical N330 glycan sequon (V3 base) and introduces a positive charge, conferring strong immune escape from PGT121-class bNAbs while preserving Env trimer integrity.

Disrupts the critical V1/V2 apex N-linked glycosylation sequon at position 151, mediating escape from apex-directed broad neutralizing antibodies such as PG9 and PGT145 while preserving envelope trimer integrity.
Eliminates the key N151 V1/V2 loop N-glycan required by PG9/PG16 bNAbs, providing immune escape with high structural tolerance.
Abolishes the loop D N-glycosylation site at position 275, providing escape from CD4 binding site-directed bNAbs like VRC01 without compromising viral entry fitness.
Removes the conserved Loop D N275 glycan targeted by VRC01-class bNAbs, driving escape while maintaining CD4 binding fitness.
Removes the core V3 base glycan motif at N330 via alanine substitution, driving neutralization escape from PGT121 class antibodies while retaining envelope trimer folding.
Alanine substitution at N330 cleanly eliminates the V3 glycan site, though lysine substitution (N330K) offers stronger steric/charge disruption.
Knocks out the V1/V2 apex glycan shield at position 151, allowing immune escape from V1V2-targeting broad neutralizing antibodies while maintaining viral replication competence.
Clean removal of N151 glycan motif; effective for escape but secondary to N151K in potency.
Removes the protective N275 glycan in loop D, conferring resistance to CD4bs-directed antibodies while preserving functional envelope glycoprotein conformation.
Knocks out N275 glycan without charge addition, offering consistent VRC01 escape.
Mutates the C-terminal serine of the N330-V331-S332 sequon, preventing N330 glycosylation and conferring V3-glycan antibody escape with minimal fitness cost.
Disrupts the N330-V331-S332 glycosylation motif via C-terminal serine substitution.
Disrupts the N151-M152-T153 sequon to prevent N151 apex glycan addition, conferring resistance to V1V2 apex bNAbs while preserving trimer stability.
Disrupts the N151-M152-T153 glycosylation motif at the thr position.
Abolishes the loop D sequon threonine to prevent N275 glycosylation, conferring CD4bs antibody escape while retaining envelope viral fitness.
Disrupts the N275-I276-T277 glycosylation motif at the threonine residue.
Modifies the conserved GPGQ crown turn in the V3 loop, disrupting recognition by V3-loop tip neutralizing antibodies while preserving overall envelope function.
Modifies V3 crown loop structure to escape V3 crown antibodies, though with slightly higher fitness risk than glycan knockouts.
